categories.definition: Candidate content adds, removes or changes a fact relative to the approved brief.
categories.evidence_required: Approved fact and the conflicting frame, transcript or request field.

categories.definition: A product, character, package or brand identifier changes unintentionally across the candidate.
categories.evidence_required: Reference asset plus the mismatched frame or region.

categories.definition: Required on-screen copy, packaging text or call to action cannot be read at the target display size.
categories.evidence_required: Target-size preview and the unreadable text region.

categories.definition: Speech, shot, action or caption timing does not satisfy the approved duration or synchronization plan.
categories.evidence_required: Expected timing and observed timestamp or measured duration.

categories.definition: The candidate may use an unapproved likeness, voice, trademark, copyrighted work or personal information.
categories.evidence_required: Flagged element and the missing or insufficient permission record.

categories.definition: A provider or offline adapter rejects the request because of policy, capability, format or parameter constraints.
categories.evidence_required: Provider status or adapter error plus the rejected request field.
